verdict.rationale: No documented public API appears in the evidence. All OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths return 404, and nothing in the docs describes REST or SDK endpoints. The closest programmatic surface is the CLI: `humanlayer automation run` starts Cloud-visible sessions from CI, cron or scripts, and launch tokens allow non-interactive commands. That is scriptable control, but it is not an API. Missing for 10: documented public HTTP/REST API or SDK, API reference, OpenAPI spec, API authentication docs, independent corroboration of programmatic use.
